ateret-zekenim/part-001.txt.1:_: And one does not bless on spices on Yom Tov that falls on Motzei Shabbat; and so Tosafot wrote in the chapter Hamvi'i, and likewise Mordechai there in the name of Rabbenu Gershom and Rabbenu Meshulam.

mechaber/part-001.txt.2:main: When Yom Tov falls on Motzei Shabbat, one says "You have chosen us" and "and You made known to us":
